security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Manage your login methods, active sessions, and password

loginMethods.title: Login Methods
loginMethods.description: Manage how you sign in to your account

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.deleteConfirmDescription: "{name}" will no longer be able to sign in to your account. This cannot be undone.

loginMethods.warningOneMethod: Add another login method before disconnecting your OAuth account.

notifications.passkeyAddFailed: Failed to add passkey. Make sure your device supports passkeys.

activeSessions.title: Active Sessions
activeSessions.description: Manage devices where you're currently signed in
activeSessions.revokeAllButton: Sign out of all other sessions

notifications.revokeAllSuccess: All other sessions have been signed out

passwordSection.title: Password
passwordSection.descriptionSet: Set up a password for your account

requirements.title: Password requirements
requirements.mixedCase: Mix of uppercase and lowercase letters recommended
requirements.specialChars: Include numbers and special characters for stronger security

validation.minLength: Password must be at least 8 characters

wipeData.title: Wipe all data
wipeData.warningFull: {strong} This action removes everything in your workspace. Your login stays so you can start over.

dialog.title: Wipe all your data?
dialog.description: This permanently deletes everything in your workspace, including:

list.settings: User settings, AI keys, and onboarding state

dialog.kept: Your login and profile remain. You'll restart from the onboarding flow.

sharingDialog.title: You're sharing data with other users
sharingDialog.description: Wiping your data revokes access to the following shared resources:
sharingDialog.householdsCount: And {count} household member will lose access. | And {count} household members will lose access.

notifications.failed: Couldn't wipe data. Please try again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.warningFull: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. {strong} Please be certain.
deleteAccount.warningStrong: All your data will be permanently erased.

dialog.title: Are you absolutely sure?
dialog.description: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove all your data including:

notifications.success: Your account has been deleted successfully
notifications.failed: An error occurred while trying to delete your account

download.title: Download backup
download.description: Save a complete, restorable copy of all your data as a zip file.
download.failed: Could not create backup. Please try again.
download.downloadBlocked: Backup was created but your browser blocked the download. Check your download settings and try again.

limitations.title: What a backup leaves out
limitations.intro: Your backup includes all your data. For security, a couple of encrypted items can't travel with it and need setting up again after you restore:

items.bankConnections: {term} — access tokens are encrypted and tied to this server, so you'll reconnect each bank after restoring.
items.aiKeys: {term} — stored encrypted, so you'll re-enter them after restoring.

limitations.included: Everything else — accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, investments, loans, tags, payees and subscriptions — is included.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.description: Replace all current data with the contents of a backup zip.
restore.fileTooLarge: That backup is too large to restore (max {max}).
restore.readFailed: Could not read that file. Please try again.

confirm.title: Restore from backup?
confirm.warning: This replaces ALL your current data
confirm.description: Everything currently in your account will be permanently deleted and replaced with the contents of this backup. This cannot be undone.
confirm.reconnectTitle: After restoring, set these up again
confirm.reconnectAiKeys: Re-enter your AI API keys (if you use any)

acknowledge.title: Shared resources will lose access
acknowledge.description: You own resources that other people currently have access to. Restoring will remove that access.
acknowledge.checkbox: I understand these shared resources will lose access.

progress.title: Restoring your data
progress.description: This can take a little while. Please keep this window open.

summary.title: Restore complete
summary.description: Your data has been restored from the backup.

failed.title: Restore failed
failed.genericError: Something went wrong while restoring your backup.
failed.unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the restore status. Reload the page and check your data.

overlay.title: Restoring your data
overlay.description: Please keep this tab open. We're replacing your data with your backup — this can take a moment.
overlay.takingLong: This is taking longer than usual. Your data is still being restored — please keep this tab open.
overlay.unreachableDescription: We lost contact while the restore was running. It may still be finishing. You can dismiss this and reload the page to check.

backup.attachmentsNotIncluded: Transaction attachments (receipts, invoices and other files) are not included in backups and are not restored.
